analysis:
Integration of 16 units: the PR removes leftover console-ui tooling after the console source moved to darkbloom-platform. Changes are CI workflow lanes (ci.yml lint-console job and route entry, component-changes.yml console output), .githooks pre-commit/pre-push, .github/dependabot.yml (/console-ui npm only), Makefile ui-* targets, two console-only fixture copies, docs and comments, merge-rules.json (drops the 'Console UI Lint & Build' required check), and CI routing/docs-impact scripts and tests. No provider runtime, coordinator WebSocket (TB-002), key custody, attestation (TB-009), App Attest (TB-011), fan helper (TB-010), add-on hold (TB-012), or prefix-cache (T-041) code is touched, and the T-041 posture (HMAC-keyed names, 30-min TTL, account-scoped salt) is unchanged.

CI security posture is preserved: ci.yml keeps contents: read, SHA-pinned actions, route job permissions: {}, and provider-test-gate. The visible ci-component-paths.py keeps NUL-delimited diff parsing and full-SHA validation. Tests keep fork-PR, https-only, exact-label, read-only and literal-runner assertions, and the forbidden-string check is tightened to cover console-ui/. The threat-review merge rule still requires the threat-model-review check and provider, docs, release-integrity and signature checks. Removing the Dependabot entry for a directory that no longer exists does not lose coverage.

Residual unverified items, none material: component-changes.yml and ci.yml consistency with scripts (a mismatch would fail CI, not weaken it); whether docs-impact-rules.json and the Makefile changes are fully consistent; dangling links to the deleted console-ui.md; and fixture parity with the platform copies, which is process-only. Integration replay was incomplete (131 units omitted), but the supplied units show documentation and tooling removal only. No findings.
